title: Manim editor project
description: A Manim animation as data. Times are integer milliseconds and snap to a 15 fps grid; positions are scene units with the origin at the frame's centre.

elements.description: Elements by identifier. Any unique string works as a key.

position.description: Where the element's centre sits; a line's start point.

appearsAtMs.description: When the element enters, in milliseconds from the scene start.

disappearsAtMs.description: When the element leaves. Omit it to keep the element until the scene ends.

layer.description: The timeline layer. Higher layers draw on top; elements on one layer cannot overlap in time.
